'''Qashmel''' was a substance used to make carpets in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The [[Hall of Masters]], in the [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], had red qashmel carpeting.
